info.title: LMS Proctoring Service
info.description: Proctoring: pre-checks, session events, snapshots, risk scoring, live monitoring and integrity review for the LMS platform.

post.summary: Start the pre-check for a proctored test
post.description: Creates (or returns the open) pre-check session for this student and test. `requirements` says what the browser must do next: accept the consent, run the system check and, for strict tests, capture an ID photo and a face photo. 404 `TEST_NOT_PROCTORED` if the test has no proctoring.

post.summary: A presigned upload for an ID photo, face photo, periodic snapshot, screen capture or audio clip
post.description: Upload the file straight to `upload.url` with `upload.fields` (a multipart POST), then register it. Strict proctoring only. Identity photos before the test; periodic snapshots (about every `snapshot_interval_seconds`), screen captures and audio only while it runs.

post.summary: Proof of life, and instructions from staff
post.description: Send about every `heartbeat_interval_seconds`. The response carries any warnings, pauses or terminations staff issued since the last one. A client that goes quiet for `HEARTBEAT_LOST_AFTER_SECONDS` is scored.

post.description: Types: `fullscreen_exit`, `tab_switch`, `window_blur`, `copy_paste`, `right_click`, `devtools_open`, `multiple_monitors`, `network_lost`, and (strict) `camera_off`, `mic_off`, `screen_share_stopped`. Each adds weighted risk, capped per type. Types a client may not report (AI findings, staff actions) are rejected in the response.

get.summary: A case with its integrity report and snapshots
get.description: The report has the risk breakdown, the timeline, event counts and `ai_analysis` (`complete`, `partial`, `unavailable` or `not_applicable`: a report never reads as 'looked and found nothing' when nothing was analysed). Snapshot images are fetched one at a time from `/cases/{id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/url`, and each is logged.

post.summary: Report the findings of an asynchronous AI analysis
post.description: An empty list means the media was looked at and nothing was found. Findings below `AI_MIN_CONFIDENCE` are recorded but score nothing; the rest raise weighted risk events in proportion to their confidence. Idempotent: a repeated push for an analysed snapshot is ignored.
